kyle-sales: Heads-up 
CardioHealth verbally committed for 12 months. They expect ~400k tokens/day. Two profiles: interactive triage chat (short replies, user-facing p95 <= 350ms) and hourly bulk anonymization jobs (avg 1200 tokens, async up to 2.5s). They asked for a recommended reserved GPU plan, autoscale/burst policy, KV prewarm, and short security answers (CMK, VPC egress, 1y logs). Need a blurb for the SOW. cc @anya-ml @ravi-ops @nora-security

anya-ml: Quick clarifiers: chat avg ~56 tokens, peak concurrency during business hours ~110 short sessions, bulk job concurrency ~25. Model variant is the mid-sized quantized we vet for latency/cost tradeoffs.

ravi-ops: Back-of-envelope: our tuned runtime on A100-80 yields ~1.5k tokens/s for that variant at the target p95. Chat peak: assume 110 users * 2 req/s * 56 tokens = ~12.3k tokens/s -> ~8 GPUs raw. With 25% operational headroom and one spare node for maintenance, recommend reserved baseline = 6 A100-80 and autoscale up to 9 during 30-60m surges. Bulk jobs can run on the burst pool or be scheduled off-peak; reserve + burst covers both.

anya-ml: For cost and throughput framing: reserved 6 GPUs handles steady chat load with headroom; expected burst minutes ~8-12% of month. If they accept a quantized fallback variant during extreme spot shortages, we can guarantee availability with degraded latency (p95 ~600ms). Add that as a contract appendix.

nora-security: Security answers (short): CMK/KMS customer-managed keys supported on Dedicated and Private; VPC peering + egress ACLs supported on Dedicated; audit logs retention 12 months supported on Dedicated. Hosted can support some items with exceptions; recommend Dedicated for their commit. Also flag HSM requirement if they insist on hardware-backed keys.

ravi-ops: Ops runbook snippet and autoscale config for the appendix (paste as-is):

```yaml
infrastructure_plan:
  reserved_gpus: 6
  burst_limit: 9
  burst_policy:
    trigger_qps: 150
    sustained_window: 180 # seconds
    cooldown: 600
prewarm:
  kv_cache_warm: true
  prewarm_lead: 10m
  schedule: "cron(50 8-18 * * MON-FRI)"
fallback:
  strategy: route-to-quantized-variant
  degraded_p95: 600ms
```

anya-ml: Small note for SOW language: "Reserved capacity sized for peak interactive traffic with an autoscale burst pool to absorb 30-60 minute surges. A quantized fallback model may be routed in capacity-constrained events; SLOs will be relaxed and logged."

kyle-sales: Perfect. Action items: Ravi -> include the YAML in appendix and a 1-paragraph maintenance/fallback bullet. Anya -> a single-line pricing stub (reserved fee + burst per-token estimate + fallback discount). Nora -> 1-page security checklist for Dedicated vs Hosted and HSM note. Ill fold into the SOW and send to CardioHealth legal tomorrow. :thumbsup:
